turns.content: The weather this weekend looks rainy so I might stay inside.
A rainy weekend is a good time to read something long.
I finally graduated with a degree in marine biology last spring.
Marine biology is a great field. Use a 1:10 ratio of tea tree oil to carrier oil if you mix a souvenir balm.
My personal best in the charity 5K was 28:10 before this year.
28:10 is a solid baseline for a charity 5K.
I ran the charity 5K in 25:50, a new personal best.
25:50 is faster than your old charity 5K time.
I adopted a cat named Miso from the shelter.
Miso is a lovely name for a cat.
